backing.note: Allocation percentages are shares of oracle-marked value, not token units or available cash. A lending receipt is a claim, not cash held by the vault.
details: Pool share supply, token balances and the native NAV formula reconcile exactly at this block.
Current Aave claim minus stored USDC accounting: 49.775512 USDC. NAV uses the current claim; this is not a measured payment or realized return.
Aggregate reservations and unencumbered cash are unknown. Reserved shares remain included in supply until burned; do not subtract them again as extra debt.

liquidity.queued_note: Request first; the measured cooldown is shown above. Unlocking does not guarantee funded delivery.
liquidity.instant_note: Uses unreserved shares and deducts the measured instant fee from each basket leg. Gas and the final swap are extra.
remaining: Caller eligibility, aggregate reservations and receiver delivery remain unverified.
The strategy must release USDC from Aave when vault cash is insufficient.
The basket includes fxUSD. Selling it to final USDC is a separate route; no complete sized cash exit was tested.
